# Dependent container seed bound

An owned method retains E extends Object inside T extends Iterable<E>, with the
same T in its input and result. Its context entry keeps String and fixed-arity
Object[] varargs; the throwing entry adds an independent Throwable producer and
throws slot. Four frozen callers compare 96 cases twice for source and SDK
providers, including mutable identity, opaque/null results, lazy callbacks,
checked/runtime/Error identities, late subtype casts and fresh context arrays.
Any unexpected element traversal fails the observer. Every recovered unit and
original metadata entry is compiled and audited. Wrong programs and Code-preserving
Signature controls guard observation and scope. Only owned in-memory code executes.
